items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton sent to FIA medical team after grueling Singapore Grand Prix
detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在新加坡大奖赛艰难的62圈比赛中后，被送往国际汽联医疗团队
法拉利确认刘易斯·汉密尔顿在新加坡极端高温下，使用旧轮胎进行的残酷62圈比赛中感到不适
查尔斯·勒克莱尔、法拉利、刘易斯·汉密尔顿、法拉利
为法拉利车迷。最新的Scuderia 法拉利 F1新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远地方的赛事反应。
在极端炎热潮湿的滨海湾街道赛道上经历了一场折磨人的62圈比赛后，法拉利车队车手刘易斯·汉密尔顿在赛后强制媒体区完全缺席。
法拉利发言人已正式确认，这位七届世界冠军在走出SF-26赛车驾驶舱后需要立即的医疗关注。
“法拉利发言人表示，汉密尔顿在比赛后感到不适，并被国际汽联医疗团队接诊，”卢克·史密斯报道。由于他的身体状况，国际汽联明确允许他免于履行所有标准的赛后媒体义务。
在线赛车新闻杂志RacingNews365也证实了法拉利车队的声明，指出艰苦的街道赛道的剧烈体力考验迫使这位经验丰富的车手接受了赛道医生的全面检查。
新加坡的炎热气候对汉密尔顿造成了巨大的身体负担，这在他比赛中犯下的一个关键战略失误下被大大加剧。在一场虚拟安全车晚期的维修区呼叫中，汉密尔顿积极忽视法拉利维修区的呼叫，被迫在磨损严重的旧轮胎上艰难地在要求苛刻的赛道上驾驶。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿、法拉利、兰多·诺里斯、麦克拉伦
这种严重的抓地力不足使他完全无法在大奖赛的最后阶段捍卫自己的赛道位置。汉密尔顿在车手排名中猛烈下跌，被梅赛德斯车手、青训车队车手基米·安东内利以及两辆麦克拉伦车手兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里压倒。起初他在领奖台上轻松驾驶，但最终他以令人失望的第六名冲过终点。
有趣的是，这并不是第一次新加坡令人窒息的滨海湾气候让这位英国车手身体不适。在2024赛季中，汉密尔顿和他的当时队友乔治·拉塞尔在新加坡的检旗后也感到非常不适。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton sent to FIA medical team after grueling Singapore Grand Prix
Ferrari confirms Lewis Hamilton felt unwell following a brutal 62-lap battle on older tires in the extreme Singapore heat
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.

Following a punishing 62-lap battle under the extreme heat and humidity of the Marina Bay Street Circuit, Scuderia Ferrari driver Lewis Hamilton was completely absent from the mandatory post-race media pen.
A Ferrari spokesperson has officially confirmed that the seven-time world champion required immediate medical attention after stepping out of the SF-26 cockpit.

"A Ferrari spokesperson says that Hamilton felt unwell after the race and was seen by the FIA medical team," Luke Smith reported. As a direct result of his physical condition, Hamilton was explicitly granted permission by the governing body to skip all of his standard post-race media obligations.

Online racing publication RacingNews365 also verified the Ferrari garage statement, noting that the intense physical rigours of the gruelling street circuit forced the veteran driver to be thoroughly checked over by track doctors.

The intense physical toll of the Singapore climate was massively compounded by a critical strategic blunder made directly by Hamilton mid-race. After actively ignoring a pit call from the Ferrari pitwall during a late virtual safety car period, Hamilton was forced to wrestle his car around the demanding layout on heavily degraded, older tyres.
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Lando Norris, McLaren

That severe lack of grip left him completely powerless to defend his track position in the closing stages of the grand prix. Hamilton violently plummeted down the running order, getting steamrolled by Mercedes rookie Kimi Antonelli and both McLaren drivers, Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri. After initially running comfortably in the podium places, he ultimately crossed the finish line in a highly disappointing sixth place.

Interestingly, this is not the first time the suffocating Marina Bay climate has physically broken the British driver. During the 2024 campaign, both Hamilton and his then-Mercedes team-mate George Russell also felt severely unwell following the chequered flag in Singapore.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯承认在新加坡大奖赛中对阵皮亚斯特里失误
items.summaryZh: 诺里斯承认在新加坡大奖赛中与队友皮亚斯特里发生碰撞的责任，并表示自己应该更多地考虑车队。
items.originalTitle: 'I let McLaren down' - Norris now accepts blame for Piastri clash
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯现在已经接受了在新加坡短道赛与迈凯轮一级方程式车队队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里发生碰撞的责任，在大奖赛之后分享了他的立场调整。
诺里斯和皮亚斯特里在短道赛的最后一圈争夺第四和第五名时发生碰撞，诺里斯在5号弯道内侧超车皮亚斯特里并发生接触。
这使得车队从比赛中只得到一分——诺里斯的第八名——并且引起了车队负责人安德烈亚·斯特拉的不满，他称这次碰撞“不可接受”。
裁判官认为两位车手在碰撞中都没有主要责任，他们在周六接受媒体采访时都没有承担责任，诺里斯告诉Viaplay：“有很大的差距，所以我冲了出去，我有权这么做。”
那个Viaplay采访的开头在社交媒体上走红，诺里斯问记者：“比赛的标题是什么？冲刺...冲刺之后是什么？”
当记者回答“比赛”时，诺里斯回答说：“哇，干得好。是的，是比赛！”
斯特拉承诺将进行全面的回顾，两位车手一起，因为这对车队来说是严重的，因为损失是实质性的。”,
周日，在大奖赛中获得第四名后，诺里斯提出了一个修订后的立场。
“我无法尝试我之前做的事情。我一开始就不应该尝试，即使那个动作是正确的，”诺里斯说。
“我必须更多地考虑我所代表的团队，而不是我自己。这是我的错误，我让团队失望了。
“因此，我首先向他们所有人道歉。我欠他们一个道歉，下次我会做得更好。”
detailEn: Lando Norris has now accepted blame for clashing with McLaren Formula 1 team-mate Oscar Piastri in the Singapore sprint race, sharing his revised stance after the grand prix.
Norris and Piastri clashed on the final lap of the sprint while fighting for fourth and fifth place, with Norris going down the inside of Piastri at Turn 5 and making contact.
That left the team with just one point from the race - Norris's for eighth place - and drew ire from team principal Andrea Stella, who called the clash “unacceptable”.

The stewards ruled neither driver was predominantly to blame for the clash, and neither took responsibility for causing it when speaking to the media on Saturday, with Norris telling Viaplay: “It was a big gap so I went for it, I have the right to do that.”
The start of that Viaplay interview went viral on social media, with Norris asking the journalist: “What's the title of the race? Sprint ... What's after sprint?"
When the journalist replied, “race”, Norris replied "Wow, good job. Yeah, it's race!"
Stella promised a full review with the two drivers as “it is serious because the damage for the team is material”.
And on Sunday, having finished fourth in the grand prix, Norris presented a revised stance.
“I can't attempt what I did. I should never have attempted it in the first place, even if the move was on,” Norris said.
“I’ve simply got to think more of the team that I represent rather than myself. It was a mistake on my part and I let down the team.
“So I first of all apologise to all of them. I owe them all an apology, and I'll do better next time.”
keyPointsZh: 车队负责人斯泰拉对此次碰撞表示不满，并承诺进行全面审查。
keyPointsEn: Team principal Stella expresses dissatisfaction with the incident and promises a thorough review.

items.originalTitle: Toto Wolff delivers brutal verdict on F1’s overtaking after Russell’s Singapore nightmare
detailZh: Toto Wolff 对 拉塞尔 在新加坡的噩梦之后对 F1 的超车发表严厉的评价
Toto Wolff 表示，即使在纯速度上快 1.5 秒，在滨海湾街道赛道上超车也是不可能的
对于梅赛德斯车队的粉丝来说，这里有最新的银箭动态，包括 F1 新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和从布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析
2026 年新加坡大奖赛为梅赛德斯 F1 车队带来了截然不同的命运。虽然 安东内利 从第四位发车一路冲到领奖台，但他的老将队友 拉塞尔 在车队最后一名陷入了艰苦、令人沮丧的战斗。
在之前在雪邦的比赛中遭遇了灾难性的引擎故障之后，梅赛德斯被迫在新加坡为拉塞尔的W17配备了全新的内燃机组件，以及全新的能源存储和控制电子单元。巨大的组件更换引发了惊人的60个位置的网格处罚，迫使拉塞尔在狭窄、曲折的街道赛道上从第19位起步。
虽然拉塞尔在比赛的开局阶段成功执行了几次大胆的超车，但一旦他到达紧密排列的中场车队，他的前进势头就突然停滞了。
当被天空体育F1的特德·克拉维茨问到是否完成在重积分之外的成绩已经是拉塞尔从受损的周末中能提取的绝对最大值时，梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫表示同意，他引用了现代在街道赛道上比赛的F1汽车的巨大、结构性缺陷。
“是的，超车非常困难。我的意思是，他完成了一些非常出色的动作，”沃尔夫解释道。“但最后，这只是与性能的融合。即使一辆比节奏慢一秒或一秒半的车，你也无法超车。”
因为滨海湾赛道的布局缺乏长而宽阔的直道，跟在污染空气中的车辆会受到严重的空气动力学惩罚，从而产生极高的"超车差距"。正如沃尔夫所说，除非车手拥有巨大的轮胎优势，否则在数学上不可能超越防守位置的车，即使领先车辆在原始速度上明显较慢。
尽管拉塞尔的赛事因巨大的起步罚分和赛道的结构超车限制而毁于一旦，但梅赛德斯维修区却带着巨大的技术胜利离开了东南亚。
在梅赛德斯努力平衡其有争议的空气动力学升级包的几周时间里——甚至运行分体车辆规格以收集数据——安东内利的艰苦奋战终于证明了新的地板和翼片元素按预期工作。
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
“是的，这场比赛很艰难，”沃尔夫就安东内利的驾驶表现表示，“而且整个更新问题，我认为我们终于看到了这辆车的能力。显然，当你排在第四位时，在这里新加坡恢复位置相当困难。但我很高兴他今天的表现。我对结果感到高兴。”
随着升级正式启用，拉塞尔的新动力单元现在安全地融入了他的赛季储备中，梅赛德斯车队将带着强大的阵容前往美国大奖赛，为2026赛季的最后六场比赛做好准备。
detailEn: Toto Wolff delivers brutal verdict on F1’s overtaking after Russell’s Singapore nightmare
Toto Wolff claims passing is impossible at Marina Bay even if a trailing F1 car is 1.5s faster on raw pace
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

The 2026 Singapore Grand Prix provided wildly contrasting fortunes for the Mercedes F1 Team. While Andrea Kimi Antonelli charged from fourth on the grid to secure a podium finish, his veteran team-mate George Russell was trapped in a grueling, frustrating battle at the very back of the pack.

Following a catastrophic engine failure at the previous round in Sepang, Mercedes was forced to equip Russell's W17 with entirely new internal combustion components, alongside a brand new Energy Store and Control Electronics Unit in Singapore. The massive component change triggered a staggering 60-place grid penalty, forcing Russell to start 19th on the tight, twisting street circuit.
While Russell managed to execute several aggressive overtakes during the opening laps, his forward momentum violently stalled once he reached the tightly bunched midfield train.

When asked by Sky Sports F1's Ted Kravitz if finishing outside the heavy points was simply the absolute maximum Russell could have extracted from the compromised weekend, Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff agreed, citing a massive, structural flaw with modern Formula 1 cars racing on street tracks.

"Yeah, it's so difficult to overtake. I mean, he pulled off some really great moves," Wolff explained. "But then at the end, it's just converging with the performance. And even a car that is a second or second and a half off the pace, you just can't overtake."

Because the Marina Bay layout lacks long, sweeping straights, cars trailing in dirty air suffer severe aerodynamic penalties, creating an incredibly high "overtaking delta." As Wolff noted, unless a driver possesses a massive tyre advantage, passing a defensively positioned car is mathematically impossible, even if the leading car is significantly slower on raw pace.
While Russell's race was ruined by the massive starting penalty and the circuit's structural overtaking limitations, the Mercedes pitwall is leaving Southeast Asia with a massive technical victory.

After weeks in which Mercedes struggled to balance its controversial aerodynamic upgrade package - even running split car specifications to gather data - Antonelli's hard-fought podium finally proved the new floor and wing elements are working as intended.
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes

"Yeah, it was a difficult race," Wolff stated regarding Antonelli's drive. "And with the whole update issue, I think finally we saw what the car is able to do. Obviously, when you're fourth on the road, it's quite difficult to recover here in Singapore. But I'm happy what he did today. I'm happy about the result."

With the upgrades officially dialled in and Russell's fresh power unit now safely embedded into his seasonal pool, Mercedes will head to the United States Grand Prix heavily armed for the final six races of the 2026 campaign.

items.originalTitle: Charles Leclerc demands Ferrari upgrades after agonising Singapore GP
detailZh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔在新加坡大奖赛后要求法拉利升级
查尔斯·勒克莱尔回顾了法拉利在新加坡大奖赛的战略，并坚持认为车队需要更多的升级来追赶红牛
对于法拉利车迷来说，这是最新的Scuderia 法拉利 F1新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远地方的赛事反应
在滨海湾的灯光下，Scuderia 法拉利将红牛车队推到了极限，但查尔斯·勒克莱尔最终不得不在2026年新加坡大奖赛中满足于第二名
在从第一排起跑并与杆位车手维斯塔潘并肩出发后，勒克莱尔在整个首节练习中施加了无情的压力。然而，由于轮胎磨损严重以及在中段比赛中安全车下的激进、分歧的进站策略，最终导致这位摩纳哥车手在最后几圈轮胎耗尽，仅以微弱差距落后于他的红牛对手，同时将梅赛德斯车手安德烈亚·基米·安东内利阻挡在第三位。
在与简森·巴顿走出驾驶舱后立即交谈时，勒克莱尔解释了比赛初期有希望的阶段是如何变成严重的轮胎管理的。
“是的，我们在比赛开始时相当强大，然后在首节练习中轮胎磨损得更多一些，但随后我们与维斯塔潘在安全车下的策略略有不同，”勒克莱尔解释道。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队。
在重启后没有选择跟随维斯塔潘找到节奏，勒克莱尔选择冒险立即发起攻击，希望通过赛道位置或提前进站的差值迫使红牛犯错。
"我一直相信到最后，但在那最后一段中我一开始推得太猛了，然后比其他人退化得更多，" 勒克莱尔承认。"但是的，我全力以赴，我不后悔任何事情。我认为今天已经做得很好了，除了可能开始时更加激进一点。就是这样。"
法拉利仍在追赶红牛的标杆
在新加坡轻松领先梅赛德斯和迈凯轮完成比赛，为法拉利在车队积分榜上赢得了大量积分，但勒克莱尔很快降低了期望值。当巴顿询问新加坡的激烈对决是否证明马拉内洛已经消除了与红牛的性能差距时，这位摩纳哥人提供了一个坦率的现实检查。
“是的，我仍然这样认为，”勒克莱尔就法拉利的速度劣势表示。“然而，确实我们为赛车带来了一些小的新的部件，这可能帮助我们又向前迈出一步，但这并不是一个糟糕的推动直到最后，我们仍然需要为赛车带来一些新的东西才能达到那个水平。但我认为今天我们的整体速度都很好。”
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队
在2026赛季还剩下六轮比赛，下一站是美洲赛道，法拉利的微小空气动力学调整证明了他们在低速街道赛道上可以发起挑战。然而，正如勒克莱尔明确表示，如果他们希望在高速、前限定的赛道上击败维斯塔潘，马拉内洛将需要更大的开发包。
detailEn: Charles Leclerc demands Ferrari upgrades after agonising Singapore GP
Charles Leclerc reflects on Ferrari's Singapore GP strategy and insists the team needs more upgrades to catch Red Bull
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Scuderia Ferrari pushed Red Bull Racing to the absolute limit under the Marina Bay floodlights, but Charles Leclerc ultimately had to settle for second place at the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix.

After launching off the front row alongside polesitter Max Verstappen, Leclerc applied relentless pressure throughout the opening stint. However, high tyre degradation and an aggressive, divergent pit strategy under a mid-race safety car ultimately saw the Monegasque driver run out of rubber in the closing laps, crossing the line just behind his Red Bull rival while keeping Mercedes rookie Andrea Kimi Antonelli at bay in third.
Speaking with Jenson Button immediately after stepping out of the cockpit, Leclerc broke down how a promising opening phase unravelled into severe tyre management.

"Yeah, we were quite strong at the beginning of the race, then we started degrading a little bit more in the first stint, but then we did a slightly different strategy to Max with the safety car," Leclerc explained.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing

Rather than settling into a rhythm behind Verstappen during the restart, Leclerc threw caution to the wind by attacking immediately, hoping track position or an early undercut delta would force the Red Bull into a mistake.

"I believed in it until the very end, but I pushed a lot at the beginning of that last stint and then degraded a bit more than the others," Leclerc conceded. "But yeah, I gave it all, and I don't regret anything. I don't think there was much more to do today, apart from maybe a bit more aggressive at the start. That's the way it is."
Ferrari still chasing Red Bull’s benchmark

Finishing comfortably ahead of both Mercedes and McLaren provided a massive points haul for Ferrari in the Constructors' standings, but Leclerc was quick to temper expectations. When Button asked if the close finish in Singapore proved Maranello had eliminated the performance deficit to Red Bull, the Monegasque offered a candid reality check.

"Yeah, I still feel that way," Leclerc stated regarding Ferrari's pace disadvantage. "However, it's true that we brought some small new parts to the car, which maybe helped us to do another step forward, but it's not an awful push until the end, and we still got to bring some new things to the car to be at that level. But I think today we had a good pace overall."
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing

With six rounds remaining in the 2026 campaign and the Circuit of the Americas up next, Ferrari's minor aerodynamic tweaks proved they can challenge on low-speed street layouts. However, as Leclerc made abundantly clear, Maranello will need a much larger development package if they hope to beat Verstappen on high-speed, front-limited circuits.
